name: Burnette Foods, Inc.
old_description: All the flavor, color, and texture expected in a well-established, quality brand.
about:
Burnette Foods, Inc. is a third-generation, family-owned food manufacturer headquartered in New Era, Michigan. The company traces its roots to 1935, when Mae and Theodore Sherman purchased a cherry orchard in Central Lake, Michigan, leveraging the region’s sandy soil and Lake Michigan climate. Their son William and his wife Marian later established Sherman Canning Company in East Jordan in 1961, formalizing the family’s entry into food processing. Today, the business operates as Burnette Foods, with production facilities across Michigan.

The company specializes in shelf-stable fruit and vegetable products, including canned dry-pack beans, applesauce, fruit fillings, pumpkin, hummus, fruit cups, meat items, salads, and fruit juices. State-of-the-art processing facilities handle canning, packaging, and private-label production for national and regional brands. Burnette Foods describes itself as one of the nation’s largest producers of shelf-stable fruits and vegetables, though specific facility square footage, acreage, and headcount are not disclosed.

Burnette Foods serves private-label customers, grocery retailers, and food-service distributors seeking a single source for a wide variety of shelf-stable items. Its customer base includes brands that place their own labels on the company’s products, as well as distributors stocking shelves and kitchens nationwide. The company emphasizes long-standing corporate relationships built through experienced sales and customer-service teams.

Burnette Foods differentiates itself through integrity, innovation, and forward-thinking practices. Its processing aims to retain the flavor, color, texture, and nutrient integrity of fruits and vegetables. Sustainability initiatives include water and energy reduction, recycling of corrugated and tin packaging, upcycling fruit pits, and converting by-products into livestock feed. The company also holds Organic, Non-GMO, Kosher, USDA, FDA, and Gluten-free certifications on select products.
